an9.47:1.1: sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānanti āvuso vuccati
an9.47:1.2: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti.
an9.47:2.1: idhāvuso bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.47:2.2: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā pariyāyena …pe…
an9.47:3.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati paññāyapassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti
an9.47:3.2: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā nippariyāyenāti. 48
